title: Add Avatars
content: Build versatile avatar component. Structure: rounded-full overflow-hidden with consistent sizes (w-8, w-10, w-12, w-16). Image avatars: object-cover with image URL prop. Fallback initials: calculate from name ("John Doe" → "JD"), display on colored background. Generate background color from name hash for consistency. Sizes: xs (w-6 text-xs), sm (w-8 text-sm), md (w-10 text-base), lg (w-12 text-lg), xl (w-16 text-xl). Status indicator: absolute positioned dot (bottom-0 right-0) - online (bg-green-500), offline (bg-gray-400), busy (bg-red-500), away (bg-yellow-500). Ring for selection or emphasis: ring-2 ring-blue-500. Avatar group: negative margin overlap (-space-x-2) with ring-2 ring-white separation. Add loading state with skeleton circle.

variants.advanced: Build versatile avatar component with multiple display modes and states. Core structure: rounded-full overflow-hidden flex items-center justify-center, relative for status positioning. Size variants: xs (w-6 h-6 text-xs), sm (w-8 h-8 text-xs), md (w-10 h-10 text-sm), lg (w-12 h-12 text-base), xl (w-16 h-16 text-lg), 2xl (w-20 h-20 text-xl). Image mode: object-cover w-full h-full, onError fallback to initials. Initials fallback: extract from name ("John Doe" → "JD", "Sarah" → "S", "Mary Jane Watson" → "MW"), display centered on colored background. Color generation: hash name string to consistent hue (name.split("").reduce((a,c) => a + c.charCodeAt(0), 0) % 360), use hsl(hue, 60%, 60%) for background, white text. Fallback colors array alternative: predefined palette indexed by name hash. Status indicator: absolute bottom-0 right-0 (or -bottom-0.5 -right-0.5 for outside), w-3 h-3 rounded-full border-2 border-white, colors: online (bg-green-500), offline (bg-gray-400), busy (bg-red-500), away (bg-yellow-500). Ring states: ring-2 ring-blue-500 for selected, ring-2 ring-white ring-offset-2 for focus. Avatar group: flex -space-x-2 for overlap, each avatar has ring-2 ring-white, "+N more" badge for overflow (same size, bg-gray-100 text-gray-600). Loading: skeleton circle with animate-pulse bg-gray-200. Component props: src?, name (required for fallback), size, status?, className. Accessibility: img with alt={name}, for decorative avatars in lists consider aria-hidden. Icon avatar variant: for non-person entities (User icon, building icon, etc.).
